['Sana Kliniken AG '].company_description: Sana Kliniken AG operates in the healthcare sector and is a leading German distributor of medical supplies to hospitals.

['DB Fernverkehr AG '].company_description: DB Fernverkehr AG operates as a semi-independent division of Deutsche Bahn that runs long-distance passenger trains in Germany. It was founded in 1999 and is part of the larger Deutsche Bahn Group, which is the largest railway operator and infrastructure owner in Europe.
